newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.338pts to 101.211.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.338pts to 101.211.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.338 points in Monday's trading to 101.211, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.006 points to 2.522 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.439 points to 97.638, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.007 points to 2.297 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 11.922 points to 1,123.393.
